# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# LAYER 3 — FEEDS / REDPANDA CONNECT (WOMBAT)                   sync-wave: "3"
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# platform-redpanda-connect: Wombat declarative feed engine → NATS → TAK
#
# Covers: platform/redpanda-connect/
#   deployment.yaml  — Deployment + pipeline ConfigMap + proto ConfigMap
#
# Pipelines live in platform/redpanda-connect/pipelines/ as standalone YAML.
# Proto schemas live in platform/redpanda-connect/gtfs-realtime.proto.
#
# Current feeds (streams mode — all run concurrently in one pod):
#   feed-mta.yaml      — MTA Metro-North + LIRR trains → tak.cot.inject (30s poll)
#   feed-hazards.yaml  — USGS earthquakes + NWS weather alerts → tak.cot.inject (60s poll)
#   feed-ships.yaml    — AIS vessels via aisstream.io WebSocket → tak.cot.inject
#   feed-aircraft.yaml — ADS-B aircraft via OpenSky REST → tak.cot.inject (15s poll)
#
# To add a new feed:
#   1. Drop a pipeline YAML in platform/redpanda-connect/pipelines/
#   2. Add it to the redpanda-connect-pipelines ConfigMap in deployment.yaml
#   3. No Deployment change needed — streams mode picks up all *.yaml automatically
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Application
metadata:
  name: platform-redpanda-connect
  namespace: argocd
  annotations:
    argocd.argoproj.io/sync-wave: "3"
  finalizers:
    - resources-finalizer.argocd.argoproj.io
spec:
  project: default
  source:
    repoURL: https://github.com/onemindos/omos.git
    targetRevision: main
    path: platform/data/redpanda-connect
    directory:
      recurse: false
      exclude: "*.proto,pipelines/"
  destination:
    server: https://kubernetes.default.svc
    namespace: omos
  syncPolicy:
    automated:
      prune: true
      selfHeal: true
    syncOptions:
      - CreateNamespace=true
    # omos is labelled by platform-omos (platform/omos), a different Application in the same
    # wave. If this app creates omos first, the Kyverno Enforce policy require-namespace-layer-label
    # denies an unlabelled namespace, so Argo creates it with the same labels as platform-omos.
    # omos carries no argocd.argoproj.io/sync-options annotation, so the one Argo adds is harmless.
    managedNamespaceMetadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/part-of: omos-platform
        onemind.io/layer: sense
  ignoreDifferences:
    - group: apps
      kind: Deployment
      jsonPointers:
        - /spec/template/metadata/annotations

# NOT APPLIED: excluded from platform-nats-streams (platform/argocd/platform-nats-streams.yaml).
#
# The live bucket KV_feed-config was created by an application, not by this CR, and
# there is no live KeyValue CR for it. It is R1 (Raft group S-R1F-*, leader nats-2, per
# surveyor on 2026-10-27). If this CR were applied, NACK would call UpdateKeyValue with
# the full config below and change the live bucket in place. Apps that create the
# bucket with their own config could then fail with "stream name already in use with a
# different configuration".
#
# replicas matches live (1). history: 10 and the other unset fields (ttl, maxBytes) are
# NOT verified against the live bucket. Before removing the exclusion, run
# `nats kv info feed-config` and make this spec match it exactly. Move to R3 in a
# separate change after that, as one deliberate edit of `replicas`.
apiVersion: jetstream.nats.io/v1beta2
kind: KeyValue
metadata:
  name: kv-feed-config
  namespace: nats
spec:
  bucket: feed-config
  storage: file
  replicas: 1
  history: 10
  preventDelete: true

apiVersion: jetstream.nats.io/v1beta2
kind: Stream
metadata:
  name: intel
  namespace: nats
  annotations:
    description: "Curated world intelligence \u2014 distilled alerts, geofence events, watch-zone triggers"
spec:
  name: INTEL
  subjects:
    - "intel.>"
  storage: file
  replicas: 3
  retention: limits
  discard: old
  maxAge: 2160h
  duplicateWindow: 2m
  preventDelete: true

apiVersion: jetstream.nats.io/v1beta2
kind: Stream
metadata:
  name: cot
  namespace: nats
  annotations:
    description: "TAK/CoT \u2014 ATAK position reports, bridge feeds, Constellation"
spec:
  name: COT
  subjects:
    - "tak.cot.>"
  storage: file
  replicas: 3
  retention: limits
  discard: old
  maxAge: 720h
  duplicateWindow: 2m
  preventDelete: true

apiVersion: jetstream.nats.io/v1beta2
kind: Stream
metadata:
  name: world
  namespace: nats
  annotations:
    description: "ORP world intel (raw) \u2014 AIS, ADS-B, ACLED, wildfires, seismic (24h / 2GB cap)"
spec:
  name: WORLD
  subjects:
    - "evt.world.>"
  storage: file
  replicas: 3
  retention: limits
  discard: old
  maxAge: 24h
  maxBytes: 2000000000
  duplicateWindow: 2m
  preventDelete: true
